ghi_chu: Chụp lại ở hàng s03-len-cong: Stage A và B loại tin cấp thị trường, nên có thêm hằng KHONG_CAP_THI_TRUONG. Bản đầu chụp từ 82a53e0a, 9 câu. Chụp lại ở hàng dong-bang-stage-b-resolve (V7): bỏ ba câu Stage B (xoá cặp chờ, dựng cặp, đếm needs_llm) — 7 câu.
cau: floor(s.latitude / 0.0005)::text || '|' || floor(s.longitude / 0.0005)::text || '|' || o.kind || '|' || COALESCE(o.property_type, '?') || '|' || round(o.area_m2)::text || '|' || round(o.price_vnd / 1e6)::text
NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM areas x WHERE x.id = o.area_id AND x.region_type = 'market')

WITH g AS ( SELECT o.offer_id, o.area_id, o.kind, o.property_type, o.first_seen, o.last_seen, s.latitude, s.longitude, ${CLUSTER_EXPR} AS cluster_key FROM sale_offers o JOIN stg_chotot_ads s ON o.offer_id = 'offer_' || substr(encode(digest('S06|' || s.list_id::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'), 1, 16) WHERE o.source = 'S06' AND s.latitude IS NOT NULL AND o.area_m2 IS NOT NULL AND o.price_vnd > 0 AND ${KHONG_CAP_THI_TRUONG}) SELECT cluster_key, count(*)::int n, min(first_seen) fs, max(last_seen) ls, (array_agg(area_id ORDER BY last_seen DESC))[1] area_id, (array_agg(kind ORDER BY last_seen DESC))[1] kind, (array_agg(property_type ORDER BY last_seen DESC))[1] pt, round(avg(latitude)::numeric, 6) lat, round(avg(longitude)::numeric, 6) lng FROM g GROUP BY cluster_key
SELECT id FROM properties WHERE stable_key = $1
UPDATE properties SET last_seen = GREATEST(last_seen, $2), n_evidence = $3 WHERE id = $1

INSERT INTO properties (geo, area_id, property_type, kind, cluster_key, stable_key, n_evidence, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_by, verification) VALUES (ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1, $2), 4326)::geography, $3, $4, $5, $6, $6, $7, $8, $9, 'stage-ab', 'pending') RETURNING id

INSERT INTO property_offers (property_id, offer_id, score, signals) SELECT $1, o.offer_id, 1.0, '{"geo":1,"price":1,"area":1}'::jsonb FROM sale_offers o JOIN stg_chotot_ads s ON o.offer_id = 'offer_' || substr(encode(digest('S06|' || s.list_id::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'), 1, 16) WHERE o.source='S06' AND s.latitude IS NOT NULL AND o.area_m2 IS NOT NULL AND o.price_vnd > 0 AND ${KHONG_CAP_THI_TRUONG} AND ${CLUSTER_EXPR} = $2 ON CONFLICT (property_id, offer_id) DO NOTHING
